description: This file defines the 'Api' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel's user API management. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting API entries, and viewing their access history.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for managing user APIs within the OpenCart admin area, including CRUD operations, enabling/disabling APIs, and viewing usage history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main API list page, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of APIs as a response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of APIs with pagination for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an API.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or edited API data.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the access history for a specific API.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the history log for an API.
